title: Everyday Speech & Aspect — Consolidation
goal: Integrate aspectual se, accidental se, colloquial reactions, habit periphrases and anecdote framing
grammar: Unit 17 review: se-aspectual, accidental se, subjunctive-emotion, soler, dejar de, estar a punto de, volver a

items: I can use aspectual *se* with whole, definite or quantified objects in everyday speech.
I can narrate everyday mishaps with accidental *se* and react naturally with *¡Qué … que!* vs *¡Menos mal que!*.
I can describe habits and broken routines with *soler* and *dejar de* + infinitive.
I can tell lively anecdotes using *estar a punto de* and *volver a* + infinitive.
